performance.verdict: Score flatters reality: intake seat empty, zero leads tracked, overdue CRM test.

findings.text: Booking bot battle-test was due 2026-07-31 — 25 days overdue. Speed-to-lead automations unverified while dispatch seat is vacant.
Leads read 0 across all 28 days despite 11 Google Ads conversions and 28 GBP calls — CPL is unmeasurable; intake tracking is broken or unmapped in GHL.
GHL shows 78 contacts and 39 opportunities created but 0 appointments — 39 opps with no booked slot signals intake leak, not an ads problem.

Google spend erratic: 7 zero-spend days in the last 28, including 3 consecutive (Aug 2–4). 3-day signal (Aug 22–24 avg $26) vs prior 3 (Aug 19–21 avg $18) is up slightly — not alarming, but zero-day pattern is chronic.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 on both Aug 23 and Aug 24 after a 17-action spike on Aug 19 — 3-day avg (1.0) vs prior 3 (7.7) is a sharp drop; Windsor lag may partly explain.
